fields.label: Interaction Type
fields.description: Link to the corresponding LMS Interactive Type.

fields.label: Timeline Timestamp
fields.description: Used for Interactive Video. Example: 120.5 pauses the video at 2:00

fields.label: X Coordinate
fields.description: Percentage X-axis. Used for Images, Videos, Drag & Drop

fields.label: Y Coordinate
fields.description: Percentage Y-axis. Used for Images, Videos, Drag & Drop

fields.label: Element Text
fields.description: Text shown in the popup, front of a flashcard, or label of a drag item

fields.label: Secondary Text
fields.description: Used for the back of a flashcard

fields.label: Linked Record Type
fields.description: Admin picks which DocType to embed. e.g., "LMS Quiz"

fields.label: Linked Record
fields.description: Links to the specific Quiz or Node ID

fields.label: Is Correct Answer
fields.description: Used for Drag & Drop validation or Poll logic

fields.label: Required to Answer
fields.description: When enabled, the learner cannot skip this interaction and must answer before the video continues

fields.label: End Time (Seconds)
fields.description: When the interaction disappears (if not paused). Enables timed overlays.

fields.label: Pause Video
fields.description: Whether the video pauses when this interaction appears

fields.label: Display Mode
fields.description: Show interaction directly (immediate) or as a clickable icon (button)

fields.label: After Correct Answer
fields.description: What happens after a correct answer

fields.label: After Incorrect Answer
fields.description: What happens after an incorrect answer

fields.label: Correct Jump Timestamp
fields.description: Jump-to timestamp on correct answer (when correct_action is jump)

fields.label: Incorrect Jump Timestamp
fields.description: Jump-to timestamp on incorrect answer (when incorrect_action is jump)

fields.label: Require Correct Answer
fields.description: Learner must answer correctly before continuing

fields.label: Correct Feedback
fields.description: Feedback message shown on correct answer

fields.label: Incorrect Feedback
fields.description: Feedback message shown on incorrect answer

fields.label: Sort Order
fields.description: Explicit ordering for drag-to-reorder
